news.title: How Sita Ramam Inspired Rashmika's Casting in Mysaa
news.summary: Director Rawindra Pulle revealed that his working relationship with Rashmika on the sets of Sita Ramam inspired him to cast her in the upcoming period action drama Mysaa. The actress reportedly underwent rigorous martial arts training in Italy and Thailand for intense action sequences in the film, which is scheduled for release on November 27, 2026.

news.title: Uncertainty Surrounds Director Srikanth Odela's Next Project
news.summary: Filmmaker Srikanth Odela faces an intriguing career juncture following mixed audience responses to The Paradise, with Nani confirming that a rumored collaboration with Chiranjeevi is not happening immediately. Industry watchers are closely monitoring which leading star will step up to back the director's distinct vision for his next cinematic venture.

news.title: Rajinikanth's Jailer 2 Gears Up for a Major Trailer Launch
news.summary: The makers of Rajinikanth's upcoming action sequel Jailer 2 have announced that the theatrical trailer will drop on October 5, ahead of the film's theatrical release on October 15. Directed by Nelson Dilipkumar, the high-profile project features an extensive ensemble cast alongside special cameo appearances and music by Anirudh.

news.title: Keerthy Suresh Starrer Dorothy Struggles at the Box Office Despite Buzz
news.summary: Despite generating significant online attention, critical appreciation, and controversy following its festival run, Karthik Subbaraj's independent period drama Dorothy managed a modest opening weekend gross in Tamil Nadu. Trade analysts are now closely watching whether the upcoming Telugu version can help boost the film's commercial performance.

news.title: Jitin Gulati Opens Up About Working with Prabhas and Akshaye Khanna
news.summary: Actor Jitin Gulati, who stars in the upcoming projects Fauzi and Mahakali, shared his diverse experiences working alongside top stars. He praised Prabhas for his highly collaborative nature on set while detailing the intense preparation and patience required for his role alongside Akshaye Khanna.

news.title: SS Karthikeya to Spearhead Global Promotional Campaign for Varanasi
news.summary: Producer SS Karthikeya is gearing up to manage the massive promotional campaign for Varanasi, the highly awaited film starring Mahesh Babu and directed by SS Rajamouli. Following the release of his current project, he will shift his entire focus toward executing a worldwide marketing strategy on an unprecedented scale.

news.title: Thaman and Ramajogayya Sastry Share Lighthearted Banter at Song Launch
news.summary: Music director Thaman and lyricist Ramajogayya Sastry entertained audiences with a playful exchange during the song launch event for Aadarsha Kutumbam. Thaman jokingly questioned the lyricist's use of the formal honorific 'garu', highlighting their friendly camaraderie and long-standing working relationship.

news.title: Raja Kumari Debuts as Music Director in the English-Language Film Impure
news.summary: Renowned musician Raja Kumari is making her debut as a music director alongside Karan Pandav for the film Impure, which features an entirely desi cast and crew. She has also contributed vocals and rap to a special track for the movie, which is scheduled for a theatrical release on October 2.

news.title: Ranabaali Unveils Historical Famine Documentary Ahead of Release
news.summary: The makers of the upcoming period action drama Ranabaali have rolled out a four-part documentary series titled Ranabaali: Never Forget The Truth. The first instalment highlights the Great Madras Famine of 1876–78 to provide historical context for the Rayalaseema setting of the film. Directed by Rahul Sankrityan, the movie features Vijay Deverakonda and Rashmika Mandanna in the lead roles and is slated for a global theatrical release on October 16, 2026.

news.title: Megastar Chiranjeevi to Make OTT Hosting Debut on Netflix
news.summary: Tollywood megastar Chiranjeevi is reportedly in talks to host a celebrity talk show for the streaming platform Netflix. While discussions are currently underway, an official announcement regarding the project is expected soon. The actor is simultaneously busy with his upcoming theatrical ventures, including Kaaka directed by Bobby and the socio-fantasy film Vishwambhara.

news.title: Director Rahul Sankrityan Reveals Historical Focus of Vijay and Rashmika's Ranabaali
news.summary: The makers of the period action drama Ranabaali, starring Vijay Deverakonda and Rashmika Mandanna, have launched a promotional video series to clarify the film's premise. Director Rahul Sankrityan explained that the movie focuses on the Great Madras Famine of 1876-1878 rather than the standard freedom struggle narratives. Backed by Mythri Movie Makers, the project serves as a tribute to those who suffered during the historic tragedy.

news.title: Akhira Nandan Shares Photograph With Nani Following Box Office Success of The Paradise
news.summary: Nani's recent release, The Paradise, has crossed the Rs. 155 crore mark in worldwide gross earnings during its opening weekend. Young actor Akhira Nandan, who portrayed the younger version of the character Jadal in the movie, commemorated the milestone by sharing a photo with the lead actor online. He expressed his gratitude to Nani for the opportunity to be part of the project.

news.title: Actor Allu Sirish Clarifies Stance After Filing Police Complaint Over Late-Night Temple Volume
news.summary: Actor Allu Sirish faced online backlash after complaining to the Hyderabad City Police about loud music playing at 2 AM from a local Hanuman temple near his residence. He clarified on social media that his objection was purely related to civic nuisance and late-height noise rather than religious devotion. The police have forwarded the matter to the local station house officer for appropriate action.

news.title: Kiran Abbavaram Nears Completion of Shooting for His Directorial Venture KA13
news.summary: Actor and filmmaker Kiran Abbavaram is wrapping up the final schedule for his upcoming directorial project, tentatively titled KA13. The film features Devika Bhat as the female lead alongside veteran actors Sarath Kumar and Sai Kumar. Produced by Sudhakar Chaganti under Joy Films, the team is preparing to announce the official title soon.

news.title: Income Tax Authorities Conduct Raids Involving Rakul Preet and Vashu Bhagnani
news.summary: Income tax officials have carried out raids involving actor Rakul Preet and producer Vashu Bhagnani. The development emerged from industry reports detailing recent investigative actions.

news.title: The Paradise Crosses $2 Million Milestone in North America Box Office
news.summary: Actor Nani has achieved another major overseas milestone as The Paradise surpassed $2 million in gross earnings across North America by its first weekend. Despite mixed word of mouth, the film continues steady ticket sales in international territories.

news.title: Karthi Starrer Sardar 2 Locks Its Official OTT Streaming Date
news.summary: Following its theatrical run starting September 10, 2026, Karthi's action film Sardar 2 is heading to digital platforms. Amazon Prime Video has scheduled the multilingual premiere for October 1, 2026.

news.title: Megastar Chiranjeevi to host an exclusive podcast on Netflix
news.summary: Iconic star Chiranjeevi is reportedly collaborating with Netflix for a multi-episode podcast series instead of a standard documentary. The show will explore his decades-long cinematic journey, personal challenges, and industry experiences, with production handled by his daughter Sushmita Konidela.

news.title: Nani's The Paradise concludes opening weekend with Rs. 155 crore worldwide gross
news.summary: Srikanth Odela's directorial venture The Paradise, starring Nani, amassed a global gross of Rs. 155 crore over its first weekend despite receiving mixed word of mouth. The pan-Indian movie also surpassed the $2 million milestone in North America as it heads into its crucial weekday box-office run.

news.title: Janhvi Kapoor adopts a selective approach toward upcoming film selections
news.summary: Following her recent work in Peddi, actress Janhvi Kapoor is reportedly being more cautious about her career choices and aiming for performance-driven roles rather than standard glamorous parts. While she has been linked to Allu Arjun's Raaka, no official confirmation has been made regarding her casting.

news.title: Ram Charan's Peddi locks its Hindi television premiere date
news.summary: The Buchi Babu Sana directorial Peddi, starring Ram Charan and Janhvi Kapoor, is scheduled for its Hindi television debut on Sony MAX on October 25, 2026. Meanwhile, rumors indicate that a Telugu television telecast might take place on ZEE Telugu during the Dasara festival.

news.title: Zarina Wahab Emotional Character Unveiled in Puri Jagannadh Slum Dog - 33 Temple Road
news.summary: Veteran Bollywood actress Zarina Wahab plays a poignant role in Puri Jagannadh's upcoming pan-Indian film Slum Dog - 33 Temple Road. On the director's birthday, the makers released a promotional clip showcasing her character Zubeidaa and highlighting a painful life story. The project is backed by Puri Jagannadh, Charmme Kaur, and JB Narayan Rao Kondrolla, featuring an ensemble cast including Samyuktha and Tabu.

news.title: Rag Mayur Starrer Anumana Pakshi Struggles Massively at the Box Office
news.summary: The small-budget Telugu film Anumana Pakshi, starring Rag Mayur and marking Merin Philip's debut, failed to attract viewers upon its September 25 release. Facing negative reviews and poor writing criticisms, the Chilaka Productions venture recorded near-zero ticket sales and ended as a major washout.

news.title: Sandeep Reddy Vanga Backed Romanchakam Locks Netflix Release Date
news.summary: The youthful romantic comedy Romanchakam, directed by Venu Gopal Reddy and starring Sumanth Prabhas and Ananthika Sanilkumar, is heading to Netflix on October 1, 2026. Presented by Sandeep Reddy Vanga and produced by Pranay Reddy Vanga, the multilingual digital release aims to find a broader audience following its theatrical run.

news.title: Nani Starrer The Paradise Smashes Records With Massive Opening Weekend Box Office
news.summary: Directed by Srikanth Odela, Nani's The Paradise pulled off an impressive Rs. 27.5 crore share in the Nizam region during its first extended weekend. Despite mixed public reception, the SLV Cinemas production crossed Rs. 136 crore in worldwide gross over three days, marking a career-best opening for the actor.

news.title: Nani's The Paradise Cracks Massive Weekend Figures Despite Social Media Backlash
news.summary: The Nani-starrer The Paradise has charged past a worldwide gross of Rs 138 crore in its first four days, overcoming early negative buzz online. Directed by Srikanth Odela and co-starring Kayadu Lohar, the film also smashed records by crossing $2 million in North America during its opening weekend. Despite mixed reviews and initial social media trolling, the feature has achieved the biggest opening period of Nani's career.

news.title: Makers of Vijay Deverakonda's Ranabaali Launch Documentary Highlighting 1876-78 Famine
news.summary: Director Rahul Sankrityan and the team behind the pan-India epic Ranabaali have released the first episode of a four-part documentary series titled Ranabaali: Never Forget The Truth. The project explores the devastating 1876-78 famine under British rule, a historical tragedy that inspired the film's premise. Starring Vijay Deverakonda and Rashmika Mandanna, the ambitious feature is slated for a worldwide theatrical release on October 16 for Vijayadashami.
